<thought>To find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Wolff‑Kishner reduction, I will search the template catalog for reactions where the forward step forms a ketone (i.e., functional_groups_formed = ["ketones"]). Using a simple alkane such as butane ("CCCC") as the target molecule should retrieve templates that convert an alkane into a ketone, which is the reverse of the Wolff‑Kishner reduction. The returned template will include a mapped reaction SMILES that I can provide as the answer.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCCC",
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
